title: Malta Year 8 Math — BIDMAS Practice
question: 12 questions: BIDMAS Practice.
intro:
**12 questions: 4 Easy, 4 Middle, 4 Difficult.**

- Work inside brackets first, then calculate powers.
- Multiplication/division share priority: work left to right.
- Addition/subtraction share priority: work left to right.
- Show your working on paper before entering an answer.

questions.title: Division and multiplication left to right
questions.solution:
\[
24\div6\times2
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=4\times2 \\
&=\boxed{8}
\end{aligned}
\]

- Division and multiplication share priority: work left to right.
- Do not multiply 6 by 2 first.

questions.title: Power, division, addition
questions.solution:
\[
5^2+18\div3
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=25+18\div3 \\
&=25+6 \\
&=\boxed{31}
\end{aligned}
\]

Calculate the power first, then divide, then add.

questions.title: A bracket and a power
questions.solution:
\[
48\div(2+4)+3^2
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=48\div6+3^2 \\
&=48\div6+9 \\
&=8+9 \\
&=\boxed{17}
\end{aligned}
\]

The entire bracket is the divisor; simplify it before dividing.

questions.title: Subtract a cube
questions.solution:
\[
7\times6-2^3+4
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=7\times6-8+4 \\
&=42-8+4 \\
&=34+4 \\
&=\boxed{38}
\end{aligned}
\]

Cube first, multiply next, then subtract and add from left to right.

questions.title: Equal priority with a final subtraction
questions.solution:
\[
36\div3\times2-5
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=12\times2-5 \\
&=24-5 \\
&=\boxed{19}
\end{aligned}
\]

Divide then multiply from left to right, before the subtraction.

questions.title: Nested divisor and powers
questions.solution:
\[
120\div[3\times(2+3)]+4^2-2^3
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=120\div[3\times5]+4^2-2^3 \\
&=120\div15+4^2-2^3 \\
&=120\div15+16-8 \\
&=8+16-8 \\
&=24-8 \\
&=\boxed{16}
\end{aligned}
\]

- Finish the whole divisor bracket before dividing.
- Powers come before the remaining division.

questions.title: A squared bracket
questions.solution:
\[
(18-6)^2\div[3\times(2+2)]+5
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=12^2\div[3\times4]+5 \\
&=12^2\div12+5 \\
&=144\div12+5 \\
&=12+5 \\
&=\boxed{17}
\end{aligned}
\]

Square the completed bracket, not only one of the original terms.

questions.title: Nested brackets, cube and square
questions.solution:
\[
84\div[2\times(3+4)]+(5-2)^3-4^2
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=84\div[2\times7]+3^3-4^2 \\
&=84\div14+3^3-4^2 \\
&=84\div14+27-16 \\
&=6+27-16 \\
&=33-16 \\
&=\boxed{17}
\end{aligned}
\]

Work from the innermost brackets outwards, then powers, then division, then addition/subtraction.

questions.title: A negative final result
questions.solution:
\[
200\div[5\times(3+1)]-(4^2-3^2)\times2
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
&=200\div[5\times4]-(4^2-3^2)\times2 \\
&=200\div20-(16-9)\times2 \\
&=200\div20-7\times2 \\
&=10-14 \\
&=\boxed{-4}
\end{aligned}
\]

- Finish the subtraction inside the bracket, then multiply its value by 2.
- A correct final answer can be negative.

takeaway: Brackets, powers, multiplication/division left to right, then addition/subtraction left to right.
